joins: each InvoiceLine to its Track, on TrackId (declared key)
each Track to its Album, on AlbumId (declared key)
each Album to its Artist, on ArtistId (declared key)
measures: revenue: total of InvoiceLine unit price times InvoiceLine quantity, rounded to 2 places
order: highest revenue first, then lowest Artist id first, top 1
planner_note: Sum price times quantity per artist and keep the largest.
text: Shows Artist name and revenue, by Artist id and Artist name. Reads InvoiceLine, Track, Album and Artist. Highest revenue first, then lowest Artist id first, top 1.
